artifactContract: Return only one JSON object with exactly these top-level keys: schemaVersion, findings, summary. schemaVersion must be 1. findings must be an array of at most 10 objects, each with exactly id, title, severity, location, evidence, repair, confidence. id must be a unique lowercase hyphenated slug. severity must be critical, high, medium, low, or info. confidence must be high, medium, or low. location, evidence, and repair must be specific non-empty strings grounded in the supplied source. summary must be a concise non-empty string of at most 500 characters. Do not use markdown fences or add keys.
